summary.prose: The code review stops calling every test unverified and stops waiting on unrelated work. Its subject now carries the Story's BUILD and TESTS records, and the coverage judge is shown each test file's latest results from the gate. The wait for a fresh index looks only at indexing work that changes the Story repository's code graph, so other repositories and document summaries no longer push a review into the diff fallback; and a review that does fall back records why.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Ground code-review coverage on the Story's test record and wait only for the Story's own indexing

api.name: resolveCodeReviewSubject
api.signature: resolveCodeReviewSubject(repoPath: string, epicHash: string, storyId: string, deps?: SubjectDeps): Promise<{ ok: true; subject: CodeReviewSubject } | { ok: false; reason: 'no-build-record' | string }>

parameters.name: epicHash
parameters.purpose: The Epic or standalone work item hash.

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: Seams; DEFAULT_DEPS now supplies readBuildRecord and a new readTestRecord.

returns.type: { ok: true; subject: CodeReviewSubject } | { ok: false; reason }
returns.meaning: Unchanged result shape; the subject's buildRecord is the Story's BUILD record when one is on disk, and its new testRecord is the Story's TESTS record when one is on disk.

postconditions: subject.buildRecord is non-null whenever .insrc/artifacts/BUILD-<epicHash>-<storyId>.json exists and parses as a build record.
An absent or unreadable record yields null for that field and never fails the subject.

api.name: buildCoveragePrompt
api.signature: buildCoveragePrompt(subject: CodeReviewSubject, grounding: CodeReviewGrounding, extraNote: string | undefined): LLMMessage[]

parameters.name: subject
parameters.purpose: Now read for its testRecord and buildRecord.

returns.meaning: The coverage prompt; the one-line build-record signal is replaced by a trailing test-record section.

postconditions: When testRecord is non-null, the prompt carries a trailing section listing, per test file in the latest run of each task, the file, its exit code and each title with its result, plus the BUILD verdict when buildRecord is non-null.
The system text says: a test the record shows passing is passing; a test is unverified only when no record covers its file or title; a failing or skipped title is present-but-failing.
When testRecord is null, the prompt keeps today's rule that every pass-state is unverified.

api.name: computeCodeReviewFreshness
api.signature: computeCodeReviewFreshness(repoPath: string, changedFiles: readonly string[], deps: FreshnessDeps): Promise<FreshnessResult>

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: isProcessing is replaced by codeIndexWork(repoPath) => { inFlight: boolean; pending: number }.

returns.meaning: { isProcessing, staleFiles, pendingCodeIndexJobs }: isProcessing is true only while code-index work for repoPath is in flight or pending; pendingCodeIndexJobs counts it.

postconditions: Jobs for other repositories, config jobs, re-embeds and document-summary jobs never set isProcessing.
staleFiles is computed exactly as today.

api.name: IndexQueue.codeIndexWorkFor
api.signature: codeIndexWorkFor(repoPath: string): { inFlight: boolean; pending: number }

parameters.name: repoPath
parameters.purpose: The repository whose code-graph work is counted.

returns.meaning: inFlight: the job being processed is a code-index job for repoPath; pending: queued code-index jobs for repoPath. A code-index job is kind 'full' or 'reconcile' naming repoPath, or kind 'file' whose filePath is repoPath or under it.

postconditions: Read-only over the in-memory queue; the queue records the in-flight job for the duration of processor(job) and clears it in finally.

api.name: codeReview.freshness
api.signature: IPC 'codeReview.freshness' (params: { repo?: string; epicHash: string; storyId: string; changedFiles?: string[] }) => { isProcessing: boolean; staleFiles: string[]; pendingCodeIndexJobs: number } | { error: string }

returns.meaning: Additive pendingCodeIndexJobs; isProcessing narrowed to the repository's code-index work.

errors.condition: Unchanged: missing repo, epicHash or storyId.

postconditions: The handler supplies codeIndexWork from IndexQueue.codeIndexWorkFor.

api.name: beginDiffOnlyReview
api.signature: beginDiffOnlyReview(repo: string, epicHash: string, storyId: string, subject: CodeReviewSubject, deps: CodeReviewStepDeps, reason: CodeReviewFallbackReason): Promise<CodeReviewStepOutput>

parameters.name: reason
parameters.purpose: Why the review is falling back to the diff.

returns.meaning: Unchanged, except the done frame carries fallbackReason and the review record stores it.

preconditions: Every caller passes a reason: 'freshness-timeout' from the proceed:true wait, 'declined' from proceed:false, 'hollow-grounding' from an empty symbol set.
postconditions: The daemon-reviewed path forwards the reason to codeReview.run so the record written by the daemon carries it.

dataModelChanges.details: Adds testRecord: TestRecord | null beside the existing buildRecord: StandaloneBuildRecord | null, which is now populated in production.
Adds optional readTestRecord seam; DEFAULT_DEPS supplies readBuildRecord (the Story's BUILD json, null when absent or misshapen) and readTestRecord (the existing reader).
dataModelChanges.schemaDiff: + readonly readTestRecord?: (repoPath: string, epicHash: string, storyId: string) => TestRecord | null;

dataModelChanges.details: FreshnessDeps.isProcessing() is replaced by codeIndexWork(repoPath); FreshnessResult adds pendingCodeIndexJobs: number.

{ kind: 'freshness-timeout'; waitedMs: number; inFlight: boolean; pendingCodeIndexJobs: number; staleFiles: string[] } | { kind: 'declined' } | { kind: 'hollow-grounding' }. Carried on the step's done frame and stored on the code-review record body as fallbackReason (optional; absent on a full review and on older records).

errorCases.scenario: The Story's BUILD json exists but is not valid json or lacks a build record's shape.
errorCases.detection: DEFAULT_DEPS.readBuildRecord catches the parse error or the shape check fails (meta.epicHash/storyId strings, body object).
errorCases.response: Return null and log a warning naming the path; the subject is still built.
errorCases.userImpact: Coverage behaves as with no build record (pass-state from the TESTS record only, or unverified).

errorCases.scenario: The Story's TESTS record is unreadable or misshapen.
errorCases.detection: readTestRecord already returns null for an unreadable or misshapen record (testRecordState 'unreadable').
errorCases.response: testRecord is null; coverage keeps today's every-test-unverified rule.

errorCases.scenario: The queue's processor throws while a code-index job is in flight.
errorCases.response: The in-flight job is cleared in finally, as processing already is, so codeIndexWorkFor never reports a stale in-flight job.

errorCases.scenario: The freshness IPC call fails or returns an error during the wait.
errorCases.response: Unchanged: the step returns freshness-unavailable; no fallback reason is written because no review runs.

edgeCases.input: A TESTS record with several tasks that ran the same test file at different times.
edgeCases.expected: The prompt shows, per task, its latest run's files and titles; a file is passing for a title when the most recent run that includes it shows pass.

edgeCases.input: A TESTS record whose files list is empty (a trivial build with no touched test files).
edgeCases.expected: The section says the gate ran no test files; pass-state stays unverified for every symbol.

edgeCases.input: A repository path that is a prefix of another (e.g. /a/repo and /a/repo2) with a file job under /a/repo2.
edgeCases.expected: codeIndexWorkFor('/a/repo') does not count it: the match is repoPath itself or repoPath followed by the path separator, as depthForRepo does.

edgeCases.input: Only doc-summarise-entity, config and reembed jobs queued, and one in flight.
edgeCases.expected: isProcessing false and pendingCodeIndexJobs 0; the review proceeds immediately when no file is stale.
The diff review runs with fallbackReason {kind:'declined'}.

edgeCases.input: Fresh index but the graph grounding returns no symbols.
edgeCases.expected: The diff review runs with fallbackReason {kind:'hollow-grounding'}.

edgeCases.input: A code-review record written before this change (no fallbackReason).
edgeCases.expected: Reads and renders as today; the field is optional.

invariantsToPreserve.text: The subject never fails because a record is missing or unreadable: an absent record is null, as buildRecord is today.
readTestRecord never throws and treats an unreadable record as absent.
With no test record the coverage judge never asserts a green it cannot support.
staleFiles is computed exactly as today (entity watermark vs mtime, repo lastIndexed fallback), and freshness stays read-only, never triggering a reindex.
The proceed:true wait is still bounded by codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs and still falls back to the diff review rather than waiting forever.
depthForRepo and repo.stats pendingJobs keep counting every per-repo job kind as today; the new count is separate.

migration.stateBefore: Per the s1 bundles: the review subject's buildRecord is always null in production (src/workflow/code-review/subject.ts:140) and there is no testRecord, so coverage tells the judge every test is unverified (src/workflow/code-review/dimensions/coverage.ts:99-102); codeReview.freshness reports isProcessing from the whole queue (src/daemon/index.ts:808-830); the step's diff fallback records only groundingMode degraded (src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/handler.ts:285-345).
migration.stateAfter: The subject carries the Story's BUILD and TESTS records; coverage shows the judge per-file test results; freshness's isProcessing reflects only the Story repository's code-index jobs and the answer adds pendingCodeIndexJobs; every diff fallback stores a fallbackReason on the done frame and the code-review record.

migrationSteps.action: Add the optional testRecord field to the subject, the optional readTestRecord seam, and supply readBuildRecord and readTestRecord in the default subject deps.
Replace the one-line build-record signal in the coverage prompt with the trailing test-record section and the pass/unverified rule.
Record the in-flight job in the index queue and add codeIndexWorkFor; switch the freshness compute and the daemon handler from the whole-queue flag to it, adding pendingCodeIndexJobs to the answer.

Pass a fallback reason into the diff-only review from each of its three callers, carry it on the done frame, forward it through codeReview.run, and store it as an optional field on the code-review record body.
Update and restart the installed daemon so the IPC handler and the review use the new code.

migration.backwardCompat: All additions are optional fields: older code-review records without fallbackReason read and render as before; a freshness answer without pendingCodeIndexJobs (an older daemon) is read as 0 by the step. isProcessing keeps its name and type with a narrower meaning. depthForRepo and repo.stats pendingJobs are unchanged.

alternativesConsidered.name: Records on the subject; repo-scoped code-index freshness; recorded fallback reason
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: The subject carries the Story's BUILD and TESTS records, coverage renders the per-test results, and freshness counts only the Story repository's code-index jobs, with any diff fallback stating why.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Coverage: the default subject dependencies read the Story's BUILD record (the existing optional readBuildRecord, now supplied) and its TESTS record (readTestRecord, already never-throwing) onto the CodeReviewSubject as buildRecord and a new testRecord field. The coverage prompt replaces the one-line build-record signal with a trailing section that lists, for each test file the gate ran, its titles and results from the latest run, and states the rule: a test the record shows passing is passing; it is unverified only when no record covers it. Freshness: the queue exposes the job in flight and a count of pending jobs matching a predicate; the codeReview.freshness handler reports isProcessing true only while a job that changes the Story repository's code graph (a full index, a reconcile, or a file job under that repository) is in flight or pending, and ignores other repositories, config jobs, re-embeds and document summaries. Fallback: when the step falls back to the diff review, the done frame and the code-review record carry a reason (the wait timed out, with how long it waited, the pending relevant job count and the stale files; or the graph grounding was hollow).
pros: Reuses readTestRecord and the existing readBuildRecord seam; no new storage.
Repo scope is correct for grounding: the callers of a changed symbol live in other files of the same repository, so their pending re-index matters.
A degraded review becomes explainable from its own record.
cons: Adds an additive field to the subject, the freshness answer and the code-review record.
Coverage findings remain limited by the graph's missing cross-file call edges (Epic c2ba6fa6 Story s1).

alternativesConsidered.name: Per-file freshness
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: As a1 for coverage, but freshness waits only for jobs on the Story's own changed files.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Same subject and coverage change as a1. The freshness handler treats as relevant only a file job whose path is one of the Story's changed files, plus a full index or reconcile of the repository; file jobs for other files in the repository are ignored. Fallback reason as a1.
pros: Waits the least: unrelated edits in the same repository never hold a review.
cons: Wrong for grounding: a caller of a changed symbol in another file that is still being re-indexed is missed, so the review can ground on stale callers.
Needs absolute/relative path matching between queue jobs and changed files.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Partial on fixIntent-2: it ignores re-indexing of other files that hold callers of the changed symbols, so the review can ground on stale callers.

alternativesConsidered.name: Keep the global signal; wait longer
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Fix coverage as a1, leave freshness on the whole queue, and raise the timeout or wait without limit.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Same subject and coverage change as a1. The freshness answer is unchanged; codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs gets a larger default (or proceed:true waits until the queue drains), and the fallback reason is recorded as a1.
cons: Reviews still wait on other repositories' and document-summary work; on 2026-10-17 that was about 35 minutes.
An unbounded wait can hang a review on a wedged queue, which the timeout exists to prevent.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Violates fixIntent-2: it keeps the whole-queue signal, so reviews still wait on other repositories and document summaries.
